name: Shading with Shadows, Specular, and Refraction
definition: A shading function that computes lighting (diffuse/specular) for a hit voxel, handles shadow ray casting, and manages refraction (continuous or discrete) through volumetric structures, supporting recursive bounces up to a template parameter.
summary: This method computes final voxel color by combining diffuse and specular lighting with shadow casting and recursive or discrete refraction through semi-transparent volumes.
